Problem Statement:
Given a numbers n and m followed by n*n numbers in matrix format print the sum of the elements in the matrix in which sum of row value and column value is even(1 base index) 
Input Description:
You will given a number n and m followed by n*m numbers in matrix format .
0<n<100
0<m<100 
Output Description:
print the sum of the elements in the matrix in which sum of row value and column value is even 
Explanation:
Assume the index of row and column is starting from 1. Add the value of a matrix to the sum when the sum of row and column index is even(divisible by 2). Print the sum as an output. (1+3+5+7+9 = 25). So, 25 is printed as output. 
Sample Input:
3 3
1 2 3
4 5 6
7 8 9 
Sample Output:
25
